topic: Cleopatra lived closer to the Moon landing than to the pyramids
hook: Cleopatra lived closer to the Moon landing than the pyramids.
script: Cleopatra lived closer to the Moon landing than the pyramids. The pyramids were built around 2560 BC. Cleopatra was born in 69 BC. That's 2500 years after the pyramids. The Moon landing was 1969 — just 2000 years after Cleopatra. The ancient world is older than we intuitively grasp. Follow for facts that completely rewire how you see history.
